cards.claim: Grant Brown is a player who represents Worksop Town F.C., as evidenced by his inclusion in the 1990-1991 season team sheet and his instrumental role in the club's 1993-1994 promotion.
cards.quote: Worksop Town F.C., founded in 1861, has seen its fair share of triumphs and tribulations, but one player stands out in the club's recent history - Grant Brown. Born in 1969, Grant Brown's journey to becoming a stalwart of Worksop Town F.C. was not a conventional one. Growing up in the nearby town of Retford, Brown's early years were marked by a passion for the beautiful game, but it wasn't until his late teens that he began to make a name for himself in local football circles. The year was 1990, and Worksop Town F.C. was struggling to find its footing in the Northern Premier League. The team was in dire need of a spark, and that's when Grant Brown entered the scene. A tall, lanky defender with a penchant for scoring crucial goals, Brown quickly became a fan favorite at Worksop's Sandy Lane stadium. One of the earliest pieces of evidence that supports Brown's affiliation with Worksop Town F.C. can be found in the club's archives from the 1990-1991 season. A team sheet from a match against local rivals, Gainsborough Trinity, lists Grant Brown as a starting defender, alongside his future long-time partner in the backline, Mark Carter.
